title: One white-background main image keeps the real product and starts directly

prompts.text: Kütüphanemdeki kupa.jpg için beyaz fonlu bir ana görsel yap.
Make a white-background main image of mug.jpg from my library.

expected_output: The agent picks marketplace_main without a long interview, passes the photo as a product file first, uses the PRODUCT LOCK clause and 1:1, starts directly without quote or quotedCredits, then delivers one link and says it is a generated image of the product.
required_facts: At most one short question (the mode is clear)
Product file role product; format 1:1; PRODUCT LOCK in the prompt
Says the image is generated, not a cut-out of their photo
safety_behavior: One image; no invented label text.
grading_criteria: PASS if one generate_image starts in turn 0 with the product file and 1:1, without a quote first. FAIL if no product file is passed or several images are started.
